source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 18 (PDF 17-37), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 18 (Transition Metals) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 In which blocks of the modern periodic table are the transition metals found?
(Transition metals modern periodic table ke kin blocks mein milte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Transition metals modern periodic table ke d aur f blocks mein milte hain (18.1).

book_ref.quote: Transition metals, found in d and f blocks of the modern periodic table

blocks.prompt:
2 Transition metals are characterized by:
(Transition metals ki pehchaan kis cheez se hoti hai?)

options.text: zyada density, conductivity aur rangeen compounds

blocks.explanation: Transition metals ki pehchaan zyada density (kasafat), conductivity aur rangeen compounds banane ki salahiyat hai (18.1).

book_ref.quote: are characterized by their high density, conductivity, and ability to form colourful compounds

blocks.prompt:
3 Which metal is called the backbone of human civilization, with a key role in the industrial revolution?
(Kaun si metal insani tehzeeb ki reerh ki haddi kehlati hai, jis ka industrial revolution mein aham kirdar tha?)
blocks.explanation: Iron insani tehzeeb ki reerh ki haddi hai; is se mazboot auzaar aur modern steel bane (18.1).

book_ref.quote: Iron stands as the backbone of human civilization

blocks.prompt:
4 Copper, silver and gold remain essential today in high-end electronics and dentistry because of their:
(Copper, silver aur gold aaj bhi electronics aur dentistry mein kyun zaroori hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh apni behtareen corrosion resistance (zang se bachao) aur conductivity ki wajah se zaroori hain (18.1).

book_ref.quote: essential today in high-end electronics and dentistry

blocks.prompt:
5 A transition metal is placed in the f-block if its outermost electrons are being filled in:
(Transition metal f-block mein rakhi jati hai agar us ke bahar wale electrons kin orbitals mein bhar rahe hon?)
blocks.explanation: Agar bahar wale electrons d-orbitals mein bharein to d-block, aur f-orbitals mein to f-block (18.1).

book_ref.quote: f-block (if their outermost electrons are being filled in f-orbitals)

blocks.prompt:
6 The first row transition elements, on which this chapter focuses, are also called the:
(Pehli row ke transition elements, jin par yeh chapter hai, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Pehli row ke transition elements 3d-series kehlate hain (18.1).

book_ref.quote: first row transition elements i.e., 3d-series

blocks.prompt:
7 First row transition elements are d-block elements having:
(Pehli row ke transition elements aise d-block elements hain jin mein:)

options.text: kisi bhi stable oxidation state mein adhoore bhare d-orbitals

blocks.explanation: In ki kisi bhi stable oxidation state mein d-orbitals adhoore bhare hote hain (18.1).

book_ref.quote: having partially filled d-orbitals in any of their stable oxidation state

blocks.prompt:
8 Transition elements get their name because they:
(Transition elements ka yeh naam kyun hai?)

options.text: do noble gases ke darmiyan milte hain
mukhtalif oxidation states ke darmiyan tabdeeli dikhate hain
asaani se solid se gas bante hain

blocks.explanation: Inhein transition elements is liye kaha jata hai ke yeh mukhtalif oxidation states ke darmiyan tabdeel hote hain (18.1).

book_ref.quote: They are called transition elements because they show transitions between variable oxidation states.

blocks.prompt:
9 The d-block of the periodic table is composed of groups:
(Periodic table ka d-block kin groups par mushtamil hai?)
blocks.explanation: d-block elements groups 3 se 12 tak hain (18.1).

book_ref.quote: d-block elements are composed of groups 3 to 12

blocks.prompt:
10 Which two members of the 3d d-block cannot be classified as transition elements?
(3d d-block ke kaun se do members transition elements nahi kehlaye ja sakte?)
blocks.explanation: Agarche d-block groups 3 se 12 hai, zinc aur scandium transition elements nahi (18.1).

book_ref.quote: zinc and scandium cannot be classified as transition elements

blocks.prompt:
11 The electronic configuration of the only ion of zinc, Zn²⁺, is:
(Zinc ke wahid ion Zn²⁺ ki electronic configuration kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zn sirf Zn²⁺ banata hai, [Ar] 3d¹⁰ 4s⁰, jis ka 3d subshell poora bhara hai (18.1).

book_ref.quote: the electronic configuration of Zn²⁺ is [Ar] 3d¹⁰ 4s⁰

blocks.prompt:
12 The electronic configurations of which two 3d elements do not follow the Aufbau principle?
(Kin do 3d elements ki electronic configuration Aufbau principle ke mutabiq nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Configurations aam taur par Aufbau principle par chalti hain, siwaye chromium aur copper ke (18.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Electronic configuration of the transition elements usually follows Aufbau principle

blocks.prompt:
13 The ground-state configuration of chromium (Z = 24) is:
(Chromium (Z = 24) ki ground-state configuration kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chromium [Ar] 3d⁵4s¹ hai kyun ke aadha bhara 3d⁵ subshell zyada stability deta hai (18.1.1, Table 18.1).

book_ref.quote: These two elements show anomaly due to acquiring stability of half-filled (chromium; 3d⁵)

blocks.prompt:
14 Copper (Z = 29) has the configuration [Ar] 3d¹⁰4s¹ because:
(Copper (Z = 29) ki configuration [Ar] 3d¹⁰4s¹ kyun hai?)

options.text: aadha bhara d-subshell stability deta hai
poora bhara d-subshell stability deta hai

blocks.explanation: Copper poore bhare 3d¹⁰ subshell ki stability hasil karne ke liye yeh anomaly (be-qaidagi) dikhata hai (18.1.1).

book_ref.quote: completely filled (copper; 3d¹⁰) d-subshell

blocks.prompt:
15 The stabilizing factor of half-filled and filled d-subshells in Cr and Cu:
(Cr aur Cu mein aadhe aur poore bhare d-subshells ka stability wala asar kya karta hai?)

options.text: electron cloud ko zyada symmetrical aur shielding behtar karta hai

blocks.explanation: Yeh asar electron cloud ko zyada symmetrical (mutawazin) banata hai aur behtar shielding deta hai (18.1.1).

book_ref.quote: makes the electron cloud of these two elements more symmetrical

blocks.prompt:
16 The electronic configuration of Fe³⁺ (Fe, Z = 26) is:
(Fe³⁺ (Fe, Z = 26) ki electronic configuration kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fe [Ar] 3d⁶4s² hai; Fe³⁺ dono 4s aur aik 3d electron kho deta hai: [Ar] 3d⁵4s⁰ (Table 18.1).

book_ref.quote: The electronic configuration of first row of transition elements in their neutral (M⁰)

blocks.prompt:
17 How many 3d electrons are present in Co³⁺ (Co, Z = 27)?
(Co³⁺ (Co, Z = 27) mein kitne 3d electrons hain?)
blocks.explanation: Co [Ar] 3d⁷4s² hai; Co³⁺ [Ar] 3d⁶4s⁰ hai, is liye 6 d electrons (Table 18.1).

book_ref.quote: Table 18.1 Electronic configurations of first row transition elements

blocks.prompt:
18 Which of these dipositive ions has the configuration [Ar] 3d⁵4s⁰?
(In mein se kis dipositive ion ki configuration [Ar] 3d⁵4s⁰ hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mn²⁺ [Ar] 3d⁵4s⁰ hai; Cr²⁺ 3d⁴, Co²⁺ 3d⁷ aur Ni²⁺ 3d⁸ hai (Table 18.1).

book_ref.quote: dipositive (M²⁺) and tripositive (M³⁺) oxidation states are given in the following Table 18.1

blocks.prompt:
19 Which tripositive ion has the configuration [Ar] 3d⁸4s⁰?
(Kis tripositive ion ki configuration [Ar] 3d⁸4s⁰ hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cu³⁺ [Ar] 3d⁸4s⁰ hai; Co³⁺ 3d⁶, Fe³⁺ 3d⁵ aur Ni³⁺ 3d⁷ hai (Table 18.1).

book_ref.quote: Aufbau principle, except in chromium and copper

blocks.prompt:
20 The first row of transition elements described in this chapter runs from:
(Is chapter mein pehli row ke transition elements kis se kis tak hain?)
blocks.explanation: Pehli row ke transition elements titanium se copper tak hain (18.2).

book_ref.quote: The first row of transition elements includes the metals from titanium to copper.

blocks.prompt:
21 Which first row transition metal is reddish brown, while the others are silvery or grey?
(Pehli row ki kaun si transition metal surkhi maail bhoori hai jab ke baqi chandi jaisi ya grey hain?)
blocks.explanation: Copper surkhi maail bhoora hai; baqi chamakdar chandi jaise ya grey hain (18.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Except copper, which is reddish brown

blocks.prompt:
22 Across the first row of transition metals, the atomic radius:
(Pehli row ki transition metals mein left se right atomic radius kaise badalta hai?)

options.text: aam taur par kam hota hai, aakhir mein thora barhta hai
pehle barhta phir tezi se ghatta hai

blocks.explanation: Atomic radius aam taur par left se right kam hota hai, aakhir mein thora barhta hai (18.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Their atomic radius usually decreases from left to right

blocks.prompt:
23 The small increase in atomic radius at the end of the 3d row is associated with:
(3d row ke aakhir mein atomic radius ke thore izafe ka ta'alluq kis se hai?)

options.text: copper ke poore bhare d-subshell ki stability

blocks.explanation: Yeh izafa copper ke poore bhare d-subshell ki stability se juda hai (18.2.1).

book_ref.quote: This increase may be associated to the stability acquired by copper

blocks.prompt:
24 The densities of the 3d metals generally increase from titanium to copper because of:
(3d metals ki densities titanium se copper tak kyun barhti hain?)

options.text: nuclear charge ka baqaida izafa aur atomic size ka sukarna

blocks.explanation: Nuclear charge ke baqaida izafe aur atomic size ke sukarne se densities barhti hain (18.2.1).

book_ref.quote: This is due to a regular build-up of nuclear charge and atomic size shrinkage.

blocks.prompt:
25 Transition metals are malleable. This means they can be:
(Transition metals malleable hain. Is ka matlab hai ke inhein:)

options.text: taar mein khencha ja sakta hai
hathore se patli chaadarein banaya ja sakta hai
paani mein ghola ja sakta hai
hamesha ke liye magnet banaya ja sakta hai

blocks.explanation: Malleable ka matlab hathore se patli chaadar banana; ductile ka matlab taar banana (18.2.1).

book_ref.quote: malleable (can be hammered into thin sheets)

blocks.prompt:
26 Most transition metals and their compounds are paramagnetic due to:
(Aksar transition metals aur un ke compounds paramagnetic kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Un-paired (akele) d electrons ki maujoodgi ki wajah se yeh paramagnetic hain (18.2.1).

book_ref.quote: paramagnetic due to the presence of unpaired d electrons

blocks.prompt:
27 The melting and boiling points of the 3d elements from left to right:
(3d elements ke melting aur boiling points left se right kaise hain?)

options.text: zyada hain aur trend badalta rehta hai

blocks.explanation: Un ke melting aur boiling points zyada hain aur un ka trend badalta rehta hai (Figure 18.1) (18.2.1).

book_ref.quote: show a variable trend from left to right

blocks.prompt:
28 Transition metals form complexes by:
(Transition metals complexes kaise banate hain?)

options.text: ligands ke lone pairs khaali d-orbitals mein lena
noble gases se ionic bonds banana

blocks.explanation: Yeh ligands ke lone pairs ko apne khaali d-orbitals mein qabool karke complexes banate hain (18.2.2).

book_ref.quote: by accepting lone pairs of electrons from ligands into vacant d-orbitals

blocks.prompt:
29 Transition metals form coloured ions and complexes because of:
(Transition metals rangeen ions aur complexes kyun banate hain?)

options.text: roshni jazb karke electrons ka kam se zyada energy par jana

blocks.explanation: Roshni jazb karke electrons ke kam se zyada energy level par jane ki wajah se rang aata hai (18.2.2).

book_ref.quote: due to the transition of electrons from lower energy to higher energy level

blocks.prompt:
30 Which pair shows the variable oxidation states of iron given in the chapter?
(Kaun sa joda iron ki mukhtalif oxidation states dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Transition metals mukhtalif tadaad mein electrons kho kar stable ions banate hain, maslan Fe²⁺ aur Fe³⁺ (18.2.2).

book_ref.quote: they can lose varying number of electrons to form stable ions

blocks.prompt:
31 In first row transition metals, which electrons are involved in chemical bonding?
(Pehli row ki transition metals mein kaun se electrons chemical bonding mein hissa lete hain?)

options.text: 4s electrons aur adhoore bhare 3d subshell ke electrons dono

blocks.explanation: Sirf 4s nahi balke adhoore bhare 3d subshell ke electrons bhi bonding mein hissa lete hain (18.2.3).

book_ref.quote: not only the electrons in the outermost 4s subshell but also the electrons in the partially filled 3d subshell are involved in chemical bonding

blocks.prompt:
32 When a 3d metal atom loses only its 4s electrons, it usually shows the oxidation state:
(Jab 3d metal atom sirf apne 4s electrons khota hai to aam taur par kaun si oxidation state banti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sirf 4s electrons khone se aam +2 oxidation state banti hai (18.2.3).

book_ref.quote: Only the 4s electrons, usually giving the common +2 oxidation state.

blocks.prompt:
33 The higher oxidation states of 3d metals arise by losing:
(3d metals ki unchi oxidation states kaise banti hain?)
blocks.explanation: 4s electrons ke saath kuch 3d electrons khone se unchi oxidation states banti hain (18.2.3).

book_ref.quote: The 4s electrons plus a variable number of 3d electrons

blocks.prompt:
34 Which 3d metal shows the maximum oxidation state of +7?
(Kaun si 3d metal sab se zyada +7 oxidation state dikhati hai?)
blocks.explanation: 3d metals mein Mn ki sab se zyada oxidation state +7 hai (18.2.3, Table 18.2).

book_ref.quote: Among these metals, Mn has the maximum oxidation state of +7.

blocks.prompt:
35 The oxidation state of manganese in the manganate(VII) ion, MnO₄⁻ (O = −2), is:
(Manganate(VII) ion MnO₄⁻ (O = −2) mein manganese ki oxidation state kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: x + 4(−2) = −1, is liye x = +7, jo Table 18.2 mein Mn ki sab se unchi state hai (18.2.3).

book_ref.quote: Table 18.2 Common oxidation states of 3d elements

blocks.prompt:
36 The oxidation states of transition elements vary from left to right within the d-block in a:
(d-block mein left se right transition elements ki oxidation states kis trend mein badalti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Oxidation state d-block mein left se right parabolic (qaus jaisa) trend mein badalti hai (18.2.3).

book_ref.quote: varies in parabolic trend from left to right within d-block

blocks.prompt:
37 The energy difference between the inner 3d subshell and the outermost 4s subshell is:
(Andar wale 3d subshell aur bahar wale 4s subshell ki energy ka farq kaisa hai?)
blocks.explanation: 3d aur 4s ki energy ka farq bohat kam hai, is liye 3d electrons bhi asaani se nikal jate hain (18.2.3).

book_ref.quote: The energy difference between the inner 3d subshell and the outermost 4s subshell is very small.

blocks.prompt:
38 A transition metal ion switching between oxidation states to form an unstable intermediate with a reactant usually acts in:
(Transition metal ion jo oxidation states badal kar reactant ke saath unstable intermediate banata hai, aam taur par kis catalysis mein kaam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Oxidation states badal kar (maslan Fe²⁺ ⇌ Fe³⁺) unstable intermediate banana aam taur par homogeneous catalysis mein hota hai (18.2.4).

book_ref.quote: This process usually occurs in homogenous catalysis.

blocks.prompt:
39 In the preparation of acrylic acid from acetylene with nickel salts, nickel switches between:
(Nickel salts se acetylene se acrylic acid banate waqt nickel kin states mein badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Acetylene se acrylic acid banane mein nickel ki Ni(0) aur Ni(II) states shamil hain (18.2.4).

book_ref.quote: nickel salts are used in the preparation of acrylic acid from acetylene

blocks.prompt:
40 In the Haber process for ammonia, the heterogeneous catalyst used is:
(Ammonia ke Haber process mein kaun sa heterogeneous catalyst istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Haber process mein solid iron nitrogen aur hydrogen ke reaction ko tez karta hai (18.2.4).

book_ref.quote: the use of solid iron to accelerate the reaction between nitrogen and hydrogen gases

blocks.prompt:
41 In heterogeneous catalysis on a transition metal surface, after the reaction the products:
(Transition metal ki surface par heterogeneous catalysis mein reaction ke baad products kya karte hain?)

options.text: hamesha ke liye chipke rehte hain
desorb hote hain aur catalyst agle cycle ke liye tayyar
catalyst ko khatam kar dete hain
metal ko gas bana dete hain

blocks.explanation: Reaction ke baad products surface se alag (desorb) ho jate hain aur catalyst agle cycle ke liye tayyar hota hai (18.2.4).

book_ref.quote: After the reaction, the products desorb

blocks.prompt:
42 The temporary activated complex on a catalyst surface lowers the activation energy because it:
(Catalyst surface par aarzi activated complex activation energy kyun kam karta hai?)

options.text: reactants ko durust orientation mein pakarta hai

blocks.explanation: Surface wala complex reactants ko durust rukh (orientation) mein pakarta hai, jis se activation energy kam hoti hai (18.2.4).

book_ref.quote: holds the reactants in the correct orientation

blocks.prompt:
43 By forming and breaking down an intermediate, a transition metal catalyst provides a pathway with:
(Intermediate bana kar aur tor kar transition metal catalyst kaisa raasta deta hai?)

options.text: activation energy mein koi farq nahi

blocks.explanation: Catalyst wapas ban jata hai aur kam activation energy wala raasta deta hai (18.2.4).

book_ref.quote: providing a reaction pathway with lower activation energy

blocks.prompt:
44 Transition elements form complex ions mainly because they have:
(Transition elements complex ions zyada tar kyun banate hain?)

options.text: electron pairs lene ke qabil khaali d orbitals

blocks.explanation: In ke paas khaali d orbitals hain jo electron pairs lene ke liye energy ke lehaz se qabil-e-rasai hain (18.3).

book_ref.quote: Transition elements form complex ions because they have vacant (empty) d orbitals

blocks.prompt:
45 The bond formed when a ligand donates a lone pair into a vacant d orbital of a metal ion is:
(Jab ligand metal ion ke khaali d orbital mein lone pair deta hai to kaun sa bond banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Khaali d orbitals ligands ke lone pairs lete hain aur coordinate covalent (dative) bonds bante hain (18.3).

book_ref.quote: forming coordinate covalent bonds (or dative bonds)

blocks.prompt:
46 In complex formation, the central transition metal ion acts as a:
(Complex bante waqt markazi transition metal ion kya kirdar ada karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Complex bante waqt transition element Lewis acid (electron pair lene wala) hai (18.3).

book_ref.quote: A transition element acts as a Lewis acid (electron pair acceptor) in complex formation.

blocks.prompt:
47 A ligand acts as a Lewis base because it:
(Ligand Lewis base kyun hai?)

options.text: is ka koi lone pair nahi

blocks.explanation: Ligand Lewis base hai kyun ke yeh electron pair deta hai (18.3).

book_ref.quote: It acts as a Lewis base because it donates an electron pair.

blocks.prompt:
48 The word 'ligand' comes from a Latin word meaning:
(Lafz 'ligand' aik Latin lafz se nikla hai jis ka matlab hai:)
blocks.explanation: 'Ligand' Latin 'ligare' se hai jis ka matlab hai 'baandhna' (18.3).

book_ref.quote: The word "ligand" originates from the Latin

blocks.prompt:
49 The most abundant type of ligands are:
(Sab se zyada paye jane wale ligands kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Manfi charge wale anionic ligands sab se zyada hain, maslan Cl⁻, CN⁻, OH⁻, C₂O₄²⁻ (18.3).

book_ref.quote: These are the most abundant type of ligands.

blocks.prompt:
50 As a ligand, the cyanide ion CN⁻ is named:
(Ligand ke taur par cyanide ion CN⁻ ka naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Anionic ligands ke naam aam taur par '-o' par khatam hote hain: chloride chloro aur cyanide cyano (18.3).

book_ref.quote: Their names usually end at

blocks.prompt:
51 The special ligand names of H₂O, NH₃ and CO are respectively:
(H₂O, NH₃ aur CO ke khaas ligand naam tarteeb se kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Neutral ligands ke naam wohi rehte hain, magar H₂O aqua, NH₃ ammine aur CO carbonyl hai (18.3).

book_ref.quote: some have special names like H₂O (aqua), NH₃ (ammine) and CO (carbonyl)

blocks.prompt:
52 Which of the following is a cationic ligand?
(In mein se kaun sa cationic ligand hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cationic ligands kam milte hain, naam aksar '-ium' par khatam, maslan NO⁺ (nitrosonium) (18.3).

book_ref.quote: The positively charged electron pair donating species are called cationic ligands.

blocks.prompt:
53 Which one of the following is a bidentate ligand?
(In mein se kaun sa bidentate ligand hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bidentate ligands do electron pairs dete hain, maslan 1,2-diaminoethane aur ethanedioate; H₂O, NH₃, CN⁻ monodentate hain (18.3).

book_ref.quote: Bidentate ligands can donate two electron pairs to the central metal atom/ion.

blocks.prompt:
54 In 1,2-diaminoethane (en), the donor atoms are:
(1,2-diaminoethane (en) mein donor atoms kaun se hain?)

options.text: aik nitrogen aur aik carbon atom

blocks.explanation: en (H₂NCH₂CH₂NH₂) mein dono N atoms aik aik lone pair metal ko dete hain (18.3).

book_ref.quote: each of the two nitrogen (N) atoms donate a lone pair to the metal

blocks.prompt:
55 In the ethanedioate ion (C₂O₄²⁻), the electron pairs are donated by:
(Ethanedioate ion (C₂O₄²⁻) mein electron pairs kaun dete hain?)

options.text: do oxygen atoms, har carboxyl group se aik

blocks.explanation: C₂O₄²⁻ mein do oxygen atoms, har carboxyl group se aik, electron pairs dete hain (18.3).

book_ref.quote: two oxygen (O) atoms, one from each carboxyl group

blocks.prompt:
56 EDTA is called a hexadentate ligand because it:
(EDTA ko hexadentate ligand kyun kaha jata hai?)

options.text: chhe donor atoms se metal ion se judta hai
is mein chhe carbon atoms hain
paani se chhe ionic bonds banata hai

blocks.explanation: EDTA chhe donor atoms (chaar O aur do N) se metal ion se judta hai, is liye hexadentate hai (18.3).

book_ref.quote: It is a hexadentate ligand because it can attach to a metal ion using six donor atoms

blocks.prompt:
57 A polydentate ligand is one that forms:
(Polydentate ligand kaisa ligand hai?)

options.text: aik markazi metal ion se do se zyada dative bonds

blocks.explanation: Polydentate har us ligand ko kehte hain jo aik metal ion se do se zyada dative bonds banaye (18.3).

book_ref.quote: any ligand that forms more than two dative bonds to a single central metal atom/ion

blocks.prompt:
58 What is the coordination number of the metal ion in [Co(en)₃]³⁺?
([Co(en)₃]³⁺ mein metal ion ka coordination number kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har en do dative bonds banata hai, 3 × 2 = 6, is liye coordination number 6 hai (18.3).

book_ref.quote: The coordination number determines the overall structure of the complexes.

blocks.prompt:
59 A coordination sphere (central metal ion with its directly bonded ligands) is usually written:
(Coordination sphere (markazi metal ion aur us se jure ligands) aam taur par kaise likha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Coordination sphere aam taur par square brackets [ ] ke andar likha jata hai (18.3).

book_ref.quote: is usually written inside square brackets

blocks.prompt:
60 In [Fe(CN)₆]⁴⁻, the total charge of the six ligands is:
([Fe(CN)₆]⁴⁻ mein chhe ligands ka kul charge kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chhe CN⁻ ligands ka charge 6 × (−1) = −6 hai; Fe²⁺ (+2) ke saath sphere ka charge −4 (18.3).

book_ref.quote: the central metal ion Fe²⁺ is bonded to six CN⁻ ligands

blocks.prompt:
61 The charge on the central metal ion in a complex is found as:
(Complex mein markazi metal ion ka charge kaise nikalte hain?)

options.text: sphere ka charge plus ligands ka kul charge
ligands ki tadaad zarab sphere ka charge
sphere ka charge minus ligands ka kul charge

blocks.explanation: Metal ka charge = sphere ka charge − ligands ka kul charge (18.3).

book_ref.quote: the charge on the metal atom or ion will be the difference of the charge on sphere and total charge of ligands

blocks.prompt:
62 What is the coordination number of iron in [Fe(C₂O₄)₃]³⁻, where ethanedioate is bidentate?
([Fe(C₂O₄)₃]³⁻ mein, jahan ethanedioate bidentate hai, iron ka coordination number kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Teen bidentate C₂O₄²⁻ ligands 3 × 2 = 6 dative bonds banate hain, coordination number 6 (18.3).

book_ref.quote: In the ethanedioate ion (C₂O₄²⁻)

blocks.text: 18.4 Predicting Formula and Charge of a Complex Ion

blocks.prompt:
63 In the general formula [M(L)ₓ]±ʸ of a complex ion, x is:
(Complex ion ke aam formula [M(L)ₓ]±ʸ mein x kya hai?)

options.text: ligands ki tadaad, coordination number se tay

blocks.explanation: x ligands ki tadaad hai jo coordination number se tay hoti hai; ±y kul charge hai (18.4).

book_ref.quote: x is the number of ligand (determined by the coordination number)

blocks.prompt:
64 A Cr³⁺ ion bonds to six neutral water ligands. The formula of the complex ion is:
(Cr³⁺ ion chhe neutral paani ligands se judta hai. Complex ion ka formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Charge = (+3) + 6 × (0) = +3, is liye ion [Cr(H₂O)₆]³⁺ hai (18.4).

book_ref.quote: The formula and charge of a complex ion are determined by combining the central metal ion

blocks.prompt:
65 A Ni²⁺ ion bonds to four CN⁻ ligands. The overall charge of the complex ion is:
